subs_ko:
가장 많이 팔린 보드게임,
누가 만들었을까요?

그는 이 게임 하나로
백만장자가 됐습니다.

감옥, 철도, 임대료,
한 바퀴 돌면 월급.

우리가 아는 규칙이
이미 다 있었죠.

서류에 적힌 이름은,
리지 제이 매기.

그녀는 독점이 나쁘다는 걸
가르치려 했습니다.
subs_en:
The best-selling board game
ever - who made it?

A jobless man during
the Depression, they say.

He became a millionaire
from this one game.

But an original came out
thirty-one years earlier.

It was made by a woman
named Lizzie Magie.

Jail, railroads, rent,
a salary each time around.

Every rule we know
was already there.

The company bought the rights
for five hundred dollars.

The name on the papers:
Lizzie J. Magie.

The truth came out in
a courtroom in 1973.

She had already
died by then.

She built it to teach
that monopoly is wrong.

That game is now
called Monopoly.
